title: Batch Test Plating
author: Innovative Solutions - Argenitna
materials: Samples dispensing from Tuberack to pcr plate
NTC dispensing from Tuberack to pcr plate

steps.title: Dispense Master Mix
steps.instruction: Dispense Master Mix from the Temperature Module into the PCR plate for the batch test (12 samples and 2 No‑Template Controls).

steps.title: Dispense Samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the 12 sample solutions from the tube rack into the PCR plate.

steps.title: Dispense No‑Template Controls
steps.instruction: Dispense the 2 No‑Template Control (NTC) solutions from the tube rack into the PCR plate.
